name: OmniEval
description: OmniEval is an omnidirectional and automatic benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in the financial domain. It features a multi-dimensional evaluation framework covering diverse query scenarios, multi-stage evaluation of retrieval and generation, and robust metrics combining rule-based and LLM-based assessments.
reputation: A recent finance-focused RAG benchmark that is useful for multi-stage evaluation, but it has not yet reached broad community standardization or long-term leaderboard status.
notes: Includes GPT-4-based data generation and human annotation; evaluates both retrieval and generation performance in financial RAG systems.
